hooks.name: Session Context Loader
hooks.description: At session start, reminds the agent of the active challenge deadline and project context so every session is productive.

action.prompt: This is the Kiro's Ghost Runner project, built for the Kiro University Challenge (submission deadline: October 5, 2026 at 23:59 PT). The project is a dependency-free HTML5 Canvas runner game in index.html + style.css + game.js. Before making any changes: (1) read the relevant source file first, (2) keep all code in vanilla JS/CSS with no external dependencies, (3) ensure the .kiro folder stays up to date with any new Kiro features used.
